## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-02-11: S-1/A files the form-of Reorganization TRA template as Exhibit 10.5
- 2015-03-31: Up-C IPO closes; KKR Reorganization TRA executed between GoDaddy Inc. and KKR 2006 GDG Blocker L.P.
- 2015-04-06: 8-K attaches the executed KKR Reorg TRA as Exhibit 10.7

#### Coordinated termination

- 2020-07-31: Standalone Termination and Release Agreement executed (8-K Exhibit 10.3); component of the $850M aggregate settlement across all five GoDaddy TRAs

## Explanation

The KKR Reorganization TRA originated at GoDaddy's March 31, 2015 Up-C IPO and obligated the public company to pay 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits attributable to the pre-IPO basis step-ups and NOLs arising from the merger of KKR 2006 GDG Blocker L.P. into GoDaddy Inc. Because the underlying tax-asset pool was fixed at the merger, the TRA was terminated via a standalone Termination and Release Agreement rather than a terminating amendment. It was settled jointly with the other four GoDaddy TRAs on July 31, 2020 for $850M aggregate; per-TRA allocations were not disclosed publicly. See `contract_log.md` for the full termination instrument set.
